title: gatewatch: merged constitution change without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 67778fabdbd8b6d8a853838c8848a5a6c9f94675; file docs/CONSTITUTION.md, lines 1-142 (new file). Article IX requires changes to the constitution to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. The merged commit is an automated/governance chore with no human sign-off evidence in git history; audit finding.

title: gatewatch: merged audit trigger change without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 27f392e55f6f356df3d22c6293c04d117c2ad991; file .warren/triggers.yaml, lines 1-47 (new audit trigger entries including gatewatch-patrol, ratchetwatch-patrol, and tastewatch-sample). Article IX requires changes to audit entries in .warren/triggers.yaml to receive explicit human review and not ride an auto-merged PR. title: gatewatch: governance commit title claims workflow changes absent from diff
description: Evidence: commit 67778fabdbd8b6d8a853838c8848a5a6c9f94675; subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), with no workflow files changed. Article I requires commit/PR titles to describe their diff truthfully; the title claims automated workflow standardization that is not present in the diff.
